meta.name: elevenlabs-voice-changer
meta.description: ElevenLabs voice changer - transform any voice to a different voice while preserving speech content and emotion via inference.sh CLI. Models: eleven_multilingual_sts_v2 (70+ languages), eleven_english_sts_v2. Capabilities: speech-to-speech, voice transformation, accent change, voice disguise. Use for: content creation, voice acting, privacy, dubbing, character voices. Triggers: voice changer, speech to speech, voice transformation, change voice, voice swap, voice conversion, voice disguise, eleven labs voice changer, elevenlabs sts, transform voice, ai voice changer, voice modifier

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意语音转换成另一种声音，保留内容和情感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要改变语音音色用于配音或隐私保护
copy.tagline_en: Transform any voice into another while preserving speech content and emotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to change voice timbre for dubbing or privacy

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行将一段音频里的人声换成另一种声音，保留原话内容和情感。支持 70 多种语言，可选 22 种以上音色。
howto.when: 当你提到“变声”、“语音转语音”、“声音转换”等关键词，或要求改变音频里的人声时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段录音里的声音换成英国男声。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具处理音频，输出新音频。

say.text: 用美国女声替换这个 MP3 里的人声。
say.note: Claude 会指定音色为 aria 进行转换。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can transform the voice in an audio file to a different voice via CLI, preserving speech content and emotion. Supports 70+ languages and 22+ premium voices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "voice changer", "speech to speech", "voice transformation", or ask to change the voice in an audio recording.

say_en.text: Change the voice in this recording to a British male voice.
say_en.note: Claude will run the tool and output a new audio file.

say_en.text: Replace the voice in this MP3 with an American female voice.
say_en.note: Claude will use the 'aria' voice for transformation.
